title: A novel molecule ZYZ311 derivatized from Carvacrol ameliorates DSS-induced colitis in mice via inhibiting JAK2/STAT3.
authors: Zhang, Fuyuan; Cai, Jianghong; Zhu, Xuanzhe; Fu, Rong; Lin, Zhongxiao; Huang, Yu; Chen, Yiling; Qi, Wei; Wang, Zhiyu; Ding, Qian; Zhu, Yi Zhun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香芹酚衍生物ZYZ311通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路缓解小鼠结肠炎，虽涉及分子对接但核心为药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Carvacrol, a monoterpenoid phenol, exhibits notable anti-inflammatory activity but is limited by its poor bioavailability and low target specificity. To overcome these drawbacks, we designed and synthesized a novel hydrazone derivative, ZYZ311, to enhance its pharmacological properties. METHODS: The anti-inflammatory effects of ZYZ311 were evaluated in LPS-stimulated Raw264.7 macrophages and a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced mouse model of acute ulcerative colitis. Inflammatory factors were quantified by ELISA, and gene/protein expression levels were analyzed via RT-PCR immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, and Western blot. The mechanism of action of ZYZ311 in Raw264.7 macrophages was investigated using RNA sequencing analysis. Direct compound-target interactions were assessed using molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assays. RESULTS: ZYZ311 significantly inhibited nitric oxide (NO) production and suppressed IL-6, COX-2, and NOS2 expression in RAW264.7 macrophages. Transcriptomic analysis showed that ZYZ311 selectively inhibited the levels of different inflammatory factors. Mechanistically, ZYZ311 acted predominantly during the mid-to-late phase of inflammation by directly binding to STAT3 and inhibiting its phosphorylation at Tyr705, thereby blocking IL-6-induced JAK2-STAT3 signaling. Notably, ZYZ311 had minimal effect on early NF-kappaB activation. In vivo, ZYZ311 effectively alleviated the clinical symptoms of acute colitis, reduced histopathological damage, and decreased STAT3 activation in the colonic tissue. CONCLUSIONS: Our results demonstrate that hydrazone modification of carvacrol (resulting in ZYZ311) significantly improves its anti-inflammatory potency and target selectivity. ZYZ311 serves as a promising lead compound for the development of natural product-derived therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 背景：香芹酚（carvacrol）是一种单萜酚类化合物，具有显著的抗炎活性，但其生物利用度差和靶向特异性低限制了其应用。为克服这些缺点，我们设计并合成了一种新型腙衍生物ZYZ311，以增强其药理学特性。方法：在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的Raw264.7巨噬细胞和葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的急性溃疡性结肠炎小鼠模型中评估了ZYZ311的抗炎效果。通过ELISA定量炎症因子，并利用RT-PCR免疫组织化学、免疫荧光和Western blot分析基因/蛋白表达水平。使用RNA测序分析研究了ZYZ311在Raw264.7巨噬细胞中的作用机制。通过分子对接和细胞热位移实验评估了化合物与靶标的直接相互作用。结果：ZYZ311显著抑制了RAW264.7巨噬细胞中一氧化氮（NO）的产生，并抑制了IL-6、COX-2和NOS2的表达。转录组分析显示，ZYZ311选择性抑制了不同炎症因子的水平。机制上，ZYZ311主要通过直接结合STAT3并抑制其Tyr705位点的磷酸化，在炎症中后期发挥作用，从而阻断IL-6诱导的JAK2-STAT3信号通路。值得注意的是，ZYZ311对早期NF-kappaB激活的影响极小。在体内，ZYZ311有效缓解了急性结肠炎的临床症状，减少了组织病理损伤，并降低了结肠组织中的STAT3激活。结论：我们的结果表明，香芹酚的腙修饰（生成ZYZ311）显著提高了其抗炎效力和靶向选择性。ZYZ311可作为开发天然产物衍生治疗药物的有前景的先导化合物。
